description:
POWERFUL 450W MOTOR - The efficient 450W motor delivers smooth acceleration and dependable power for daily commuting, neighborhood travel, and short-distance errands. Three selectable speed modes provide top speeds of approximately 9, 12, and 16 MPH.

280WH BATTERY PERFORMANCE - Equipped with a 280Wh rechargeable battery for reliable everyday transportation. Actual riding range and performance may vary depending on rider weight, speed mode, road conditions, incline, temperature, and riding habits.

DAYLIGHT-VIEWABLE LED DISPLAY - The handlebar-mounted display clearly shows real-time speed, remaining battery power, headlight status, and the selected riding mode. Convenient controls keep essential riding information within easy view.

ADJUSTABLE COMFORT SEAT - The wide cushioned saddle can be adjusted to accommodate different rider heights and provide improved comfort during longer trips. The spacious non-slip deck supports a stable and relaxed riding position.

COMMUTER-READY SAFETY & STORAGE - Front and rear disc brakes provide responsive stopping control, while the bright front headlight improves visibility. Full fenders help block road spray, and the rear cargo basket offers convenient storage for bags, groceries, and daily essentials.
